Groom rides bicycle in unique wedding procession in Maharashtra

In Akola, Maharashtra, a groom rode a bicycle to his wedding, accompanied by approximately 100 other cyclists. The event, named 'Ride for Love', aimed to combine wedding celebrations with messages of love, fitness, and environmental protection. The groom and his procession were adorned with flowers.
